svg.aria-label: The knowledge substrate. A citation graph whose important nodes are measured, not nominated.
svg.text: A citation graph whose important nodes are measured, not nominated.
218 skill files. The hubs are measured from the citation graph.
Counts citations between skill files and
fails a commit when CLAUDE.md stops
The defect it was built for
agent-00 cited a section anchor that did
not resolve. The spec validator was handed
Nine layers group the graph; they do not rank it
A skill file is a measured hub when twenty or more other skill files cite it, and each hub is drawn at a
size read from that count. Three files are also declared Level 0 by hand; the pre-commit check keeps the
written register naming every measured hub, so the two cannot quietly drift apart. The one coral edge is
the anchor that resolved to nothing.
Evidence: shipped - skill-ref-count.ts --check-level0, .husky/pre-commit; counts measured 13 Sep
